job.title: Licenced Conveyancer / Conveyancing Paralegal
job.description:
An opportunity has arisen for an experienced Conveyancing Paralegal or Licensed Conveyancer to join a highly regarded, commercially focused law firm in Sydney, working within a busy and collaborative Real Estate team.

The Role:
Working closely with experienced property lawyers, your responsibilities will include:

  • Managing conveyancing files independently from start to finish, including large-scale transactions and settlements.
  • Supporting commercial property acquisitions and disposals, including due diligence and contract management.
  • Preparing, reviewing and coordinating property contracts, settlement documentation and related legal documents.
  • Managing PEXA workspaces, electronic settlements, title searches and property searches.
  • Coordinating with clients, solicitors, lenders, agents and other stakeholders to ensure transactions progress smoothly.
  • Managing a busy workload, monitoring key dates and ensuring deadlines are met.

Please note: A conveyancing licence is welcome but not essential. Candidates with strong commercial conveyancing experience from boutique, mid-tier or top-tier firms are encouraged to apply!

The Perks:

  • High-quality commercial work
  • Autonomy and ownership
  • Flexible working
  • Career development
  • Health and wellbeing benefits
  • Join a firm that values diversity, collaboration and employee wellbeing

Applicants must hold Australian citizenship or permanent residency, with unrestricted working rights. Unfortunately, this role is not suitable for students.

job.title: Legal Secretary - Top Tier Firm - Corporate
job.description:
The Opportunity:
Join a nationally recognised full-service law firm, they have roles in both litigated and transactional practice areas. You will support 1 Partner, who is approachable and highly tech-savvy—along with a small team of lawyers. The firm is known for its stability, with an exceptionally low staff turnover. This role also offers an excellent work-life balance, including one day of work-from-home per week and minimal to no overtime. This is a newly created position.

The Role:
You will provide support to a Partner and a small legal team handling matters for their various clients. The Partners are down-to-earth and friendly, and the firm fosters a genuinely welcoming and collegial environment. Your responsibilities will focus on typical Legal Secretary tasks with very few personal assistant duties. These include:

  • Monthly billing
  • Diary and email management
  • Court filing
  • Liaising with clients
  • Expense management

About You:
As this role sits within a top-tier law firm, you will need experience at a reputable law firm, and you will have supported up to the Partner level. The ability to work as a team and on your own when needed.

What You Will Get:
A salary package of up to $100K, annual salary reviews, one day of remote work per week, a wellbeing program, a subsidised gym membership, five-star end-of-trip facilities, and the opportunity to join a stable, down-to-earth team with a positive and genuine culture.

job.title: Legal Secretary - Projects & Energy
job.description:
A leading global law firm has an exciting opportunity for an experienced Legal Executive to join its Projects & Energy team.

The Role

  • Unheard-of salary package: Up to $115,000 package
  • Quality work without being stuck doing purely admin: You’d be supporting a Partners working on sophisticated transactional and government matters, so there’s good exposure to interesting legal work and senior stakeholders.
  • A genuinely good PA setup: enough ownership and responsibility without being spread across a huge team. You’re likely to build strong relationships with the Partners you support and become someone they genuinely rely on.
  • Joining a large international firm comes with a solid structure, resources, and career opportunities, without necessarily sacrificing the team environment.
  • WFH flexibility on offer

You’ll have legal support experience with excellent organisational skills, strong attention to detail, and the confidence to support busy lawyers across a varied workload.

This is a permanent role. You will need Permanent Residency or Australian Citizenship to be considered. No students will be considered for this role.
